headline: Bruus is spared a rebuke as the government's support parties refuse to back one
deck: The Defence Command admitted on Thursday that soldiers fired shots while a Norwegian passenger plane flew overhead.
standard: Jeppe Bruus, the defence minister, will not receive a 'næse', the Folketing's symbolic rebuke, over errors in the Defence Command's account of the drone incidents. Enhedslisten and Alternativet, the government's two support parties, will not back one, which leaves several centre-right parties led by Dansk Folkeparti without the votes.
On Thursday the Defence Command admitted that Danish soldiers fired shots while a Norwegian passenger plane flew over Borris firing range in September 2025. It denies firing at the plane.
Eva Flyvholm, Enhedslisten's defence spokesperson, said a rebuke 'solves nothing' because Bruus was not minister at the time.
short: Jeppe Bruus, the defence minister, will not receive the Folketing's symbolic rebuke over errors in the Defence Command's drone account. Enhedslisten and Alternativet will not back one, so the parties led by Dansk Folkeparti lack the votes.
